title: spec: an upgrade-guide entry for a dataset or cube dimension over a formula field, now refused at authoring (follow-up to #30773)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1SZmabyrNd3YLCq3J

Follow-up to #30773 (PR #30815), from the seat's ruling on contract review [6677341880](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/30815#issuecomment-6677341880), should-fix 2. It is spec-lane work and out of scope for that PR.

## What is missing

PR #30815 makes a dataset or `analyticsCubes` dimension over a virtual (`formula`) field an authoring-time refusal: the dataset compile answers `400 DATASET_INVALID`, and lint answers `dimension-virtual-field-refused` on `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and at the runtime dataset save (`422`). Its changeset declares `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` with the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

The upgrade guide has no entry for it, so an author upgrading across the release that ships #30773 learns about the dimension only when the dataset stops compiling. The measure-side sibling has one: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.dataset-measure-aggregate-field-type-refused.ts`.

## What is wanted

A semantic migration entry under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`, mirroring `18.dataset-measure-aggregate-field-type-refused`, for a dataset (or cube) dimension over a virtual field:

- no automatic rewrite (which stored field should carry the value is the author's judgement);
- the replacement named: store the value in a field of its own on the object (written by a hook or a flow when its source changes) and point the dimension at that field, or remove the dimension;
- `relevantWhen` on `datasets` and `analyticsCubes`.

It should land before the release that ships #30773.
